name: 7.18% GOI 2033 Sovereign Bond
advantages: Zero default risk backed by sovereign guarantee; benchmark liquidity in wholesale and retail markets; steady semi-annual cash flow.
risks: Interest rate risk if central bank raises repo rates; yield fluctuates with macro inflation and bond supply.

name: HDFC Bank Tier-II Subordinated Bond
advantages: High credit quality from India's largest private bank; attractive yield pickup over sovereign benchmark curve.
risks: Subordinated status in capital hierarchy compared to senior depositors; lower secondary market liquidity for retail investors.

name: NABARD Tax-Free Infrastructure Bond
issuer: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
advantages: Interest income completely exempt from Indian income tax under section 10(15)(iv)(h); excellent for high-tax bracket earners.
risks: Long lock-in duration; secondary market trading spreads can widen; yield is lower on gross basis for non-taxpayers.

name: Power Finance Corp 7.55% 2029
advantages: State-owned Maharatna financial company with quasi-sovereign support; quarterly or annual steady income stream.
risks: Concentration in state power discom financing; macro interest rate cycles affect capital appreciation.

name: Tata Capital Financial Services NCD
advantages: Attractive regular monthly income option; backed by reputable Tata Group governance; high coupon rate.
risks: Credit spread risk if NBFC funding environment tightens; subordinated to senior secured obligations.
